rows.label: tlk70000122_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Hey, hey. Your formation
is a complete mess!

rows.label: tlk70000122_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Well, no worries... Here comes
a lecture direct from a pro
adventurer! That's yours truly...

rows.label: tlk70000122_02_msg0003
rows.name:
The basics of formation are dividing
the roles into attacker and supporter.

rows.label: tlk70000122_02_msg0004
rows.name:
The attacker is the main offensive
force and takes all the enemy's
attacks...

rows.label: tlk70000122_02_msg0005
rows.name:
The supporter backs up the attacker
and won't be targeted by the enemy.

rows.label: tlk70000122_02_msg0006
rows.name:
Of course, an expert adventurer like
me can defeat any enemy alone!
